Name: peachdelta's Jessie and Juliet Portraits
Author: peachdelta
Description:
This is my first attempt at a portrait mod, so I hope you like it! It's only PNGs, but if anyone wants to make a Content Patcher version, please go ahead as long as I'm still credited for the art.

To change the portraits, just go into[b] C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Juliet & Jessie (1.6)\assets[/b] and replace the "Portraits" folder with the one contained in [i][b]this [/b][/i]download.
